text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina was set to make her
Debut at Sapporo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her Twinkle Series begins here,
facing her nervous debut race, but—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis~!
Look!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Found a nice monument,
so took a pic with Cheval-chi ♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how cute!
It's shaped like a proper heart too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Because Vivlos forced me to...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I mean, everything's been so forced on me...
I never thought I'd end up all the way in Sapporo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yes, tagging along with Verxina, her two younger sisters came all the way to Hokkaido too. Since neither has debuted yet, they were free to make the trip."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I bet you begged Dad and the others, didn't you?
Both of them are far too soft on you..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No! Mom told me,
"Go tag along with them~"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether by chance or foresight...
the fact that the two of them came along had a positive effect on Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since witnessing Gentildonna's declaration of intent,
Verxina seemed overly tense, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Sis wouldn't want that either.
Treating it like a game...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No?
Having the two of you here is truly reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Tarumae-san told me about
some souvenirs that are trending on Umastagram.
Let's check them out on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
!!
Yay! I wanna watch♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You too, Cheval.
I heard they have delicious seafood steamed buns, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
!
Meat buns...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait.
I told you, we didn't come here to play."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right!
It's a race, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Good luck, Big Sis!
I'll be cheering for you from the best seat in the house♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Watch over me with confidence.
I won't show you a pathetic run!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Cheered on by her sisters, Verxina seemed to channel
her motivation in the right direction.
She has worked diligently toward this very day."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
We made it in time, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is
to put on a run worthy of the pinnacle...
choice_data_list: Let's see how far we can go!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
To see where I currently stand...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"My little sisters are watching as well.
—Let us make a spectacular start!"
